words.meaning: A broad, flat, flexible blade used to mix, spread, and lift food items.
sentences: She used a silicone spatula to scrape the batter from the bowl.
Flip the pancake carefully using a flat spatula.
Make sure to clean the spatula after cooking.

words.meaning: A bowl-shaped kitchen utensil with holes used for draining liquids from food.
sentences: Pour the cooked pasta into a colander to drain the water.
Wash the fresh berries in a stainless steel colander.
Place the colander in the sink before pouring out the hot water.

words.meaning: A cooking utensil made of wire loops, used for beating or whipping ingredients.
sentences: Use a wire whisk to combine the flour and baking powder evenly.
Beat the egg whites with a whisk until soft peaks form.
She bought a new stainless steel whisk for baking.

words.meaning: To cook food gently in liquid kept just below the boiling point.

translations.hindi: धीमी आंच पर पकाना (Dheemi aanch par pakana)

sentences: Lower the heat and let the soup simmer for twenty minutes.
The sauce needs to simmer slowly so the flavors can blend together.
Cover the pot and simmer the stew on low heat.

words.meaning: A large long-handled spoon with a deep bowl, used for serving soup or liquid food.
sentences: He used a big ladle to pour the hot soup into bowls.
Always keep a ladle near the pot when cooking curry.
The soup ladle is made of heat-resistant plastic.
